title: How the OpenAI, Anthropic IPOs Could Lift the Veil on AI Economics
text: VistaShares portfolio manager and DVX Ventures principal David Fetherstonhaugh says investors are increasingly looking for proof that massive AI spending is generating returns. He discusses why private companies like OpenAI and Anthropic leave a key part of the AI economy opaque and how their eventual IPOs could bring greater transparency to the ecosystem. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
